baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal predication, priorness, and voiced approach combine into a durable practice of address already in place before the present testimony.

activation_trace.role: The temporal-occurrence branch supplies the past habitual frame, making the calling a settled practice.
The priorness branch supplies the pre-rescue interval and turns before into meaningful lead time.
The voiced-nearness branch supplies address as relation-seeking action rather than bare recollection.

changed_reading.after: Their present testimony identifies prior, repeated address as a relationship established before rescue.

baseline_models.mechanism: The emphatic identification names the addressee through goodness whose word and deed hold, expansive beneficence, and tenderness toward the vulnerable.

activation_trace.role: The truth-that-holds branch supplies reliable enactment, making the title more than a moral abstraction.
The expansive-goodness branch supplies the breadth of beneficence available to the callers.
The mercy-and-tenderness branch supplies affective movement toward those exposed to harm.

changed_reading.after: The paired titles explain why calling Him is not void: His goodness holds in action and His tenderness reaches the caller.

baseline_models.mechanism: The claim-of-affiliation branch of calling can coexist with petition: they avow whose people they are, and the paired titles describe bond-maintaining kindness rather than estrangement.

activation_trace.role: The affiliation-claim branch supplies an avowal of belonging within the act of calling.
The dutiful-kindness branch supplies maintained connection as the opposite of severance.
The kinship-bond branch gives the claimed relation a familial rather than transactional shape.

changed_reading.after: Their call can also be an avowal of belonging to the One who maintains bonds and refuses estrangement.

baseline_models.mechanism: Two remote nominal branches create a spatial pair: dry open land offers footing while the womb offers enclosing protection; the titles can carry both stability and nurture without losing their ordinary ethical force.

activation_trace.role: The dry-land branch supplies firm exposed ground as a spatial affordance of the title.
The womb branch supplies an enclosing place in which vulnerable life is protected and grown.

changed_reading.before: The two titles are parallel qualities.
changed_reading.after: They can also coexist as a material polarity of safe footing and protective enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The saved group is introduced through protection and a screened garden, then the Lord's warding is repeated immediately before the focus. The closing titles therefore name capacities already enacted rather than abstract qualities added after the fact.

activation_trace.role: The expansive-goodness branch supplies the positive abundance into which protection admits them.
The tenderness branch supplies the motive for moving vulnerable people beyond harm.
The self-in-protection branch supplies the saved group's defining posture at its first appearance.
The tree-screened-garden branch supplies a destination whose abundance is also sheltering.
The warding-of-harm branch supplies the Lord's concrete protective action.
The repeated warding branch makes protection the speakers' immediate premise for naming Him.

structural_cues: 52:17 introduces the protected group inside gardens, 52:18 attributes their protection to their Lord, and 52:27 repeats that action in first-person testimony.
The focus follows the report of protection with emphatic identification of the protector.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a protected posture, screened abundance, repeated divine warding, and the paired titles; I infer that the titles explain the action just narrated, while the live alternative is that they remain a general doxology after rescue.

changed_reading.after: His expansive goodness and mercy are visible as a repeated act of warding people into sheltered abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from fruit through eating, drinking without harm, connected increase, and provision of meat. Against that material field, the grain branch of البر activates a nourishing register: goodness does not merely remove danger but sustains embodied appetite without depletion or injury.

activation_trace.role: The grain-and-wheat branch supplies staple nourishment as a material resonance of the title.
The pleasant-fruit branch supplies desirable nourishment rather than bare subsistence.
The taking-food branch supplies embodied reception of the provided good.
The taking-liquid branch broadens nourishment from solid provision to complete bodily refreshment.
The ease-without-harm branch supplies nourishment freed from toil and harmful aftermath.
The connected-increase branch supplies continuing replenishment rather than a finite ration.
The meat-provision branch supplies desired food as a granted livelihood.

structural_cues: 52:19 commands eating and drinking with an adverb of harmless ease, while 52:22 adds ongoing fruit and meat according to desire.
The focus's title البر arrives after this dense material inventory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the remote grain branch and a sustained food sequence; I infer that beneficence can be experienced as bodily nourishment and replenishment, while the live alternative is that the grain branch remains homonymic and the ethical title alone governs.

changed_reading.after: Alongside general goodness, البر acquires a nourishing register: provision received, replenished, desired, and made harmless.

context_deltas.mechanism: Enjoyment is related to intended deeds, no deed is diminished, and each person remains held to what was earned; yet rescue is finally narrated as release without price. The paired titles can therefore hold two irreducible relations at once: reliable consequence and gratuitous mercy.

activation_trace.role: The truth-that-makes-deed-hold branch supplies reliable consequence rather than arbitrary outcome.
The tenderness branch supplies gift that exceeds a strict account of earning.
The intended-deed branch supplies purposeful action as one stated relation to enjoyment.
The diminution branch supplies the explicitly denied loss of anyone's deed.
The acquisition branch supplies personal earning as an enduring axis of agency.
The right-held-as-pledge branch supplies the binding relation between person and acquisition.
The release-without-price branch supplies rescue as gift rather than settled payment.

structural_cues: 52:19 and 52:21 preserve the language of deeds, undiminished work, earning, and pledging.
52:27 changes register to divine favor before the focus names البر الرحيم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deed-consequence, preserved earning, binding pledge, and unpriced release; I infer that البر and الرحيم keep consequence and gift co-present, while the live alternative is that reward and favor are complementary without any felt tension.

changed_reading.before: The titles simply confirm that the callers were rewarded.
changed_reading.after: The title pair keeps earned consequence and unpriced release together: goodness lets deeds hold, while mercy is not reducible to wages.

context_deltas.mechanism: Secure trust lets descendants follow; those pictured as small and dispersed catch up with those ahead; the following food verse unexpectedly offers a kinship-fabric branch. Together these cues give the focus's anti-estrangement and kinship branches a concrete social mechanism.

activation_trace.role: The kindness-against-estrangement branch supplies maintained family connection.
The kinship-bond branch makes lineage preservation an activated dimension of mercy.
The heart-at-rest-in-trust branch supplies the stable condition shared across generations.
The following-behind branch supplies the descendants' ordered relation to those before them.
The smallness-and-dispersal branch supplies the vulnerability and separation of descendants.
The catching-up branch supplies the act that closes generational distance.
The kinship-and-loyalty-fabric branch supplies an unexpected image of the reunited lineage holding together.

structural_cues: 52:21 repeats descendants on both sides of the joining verb, then preserves each person's earned responsibility.
The focus pairs relational calling with titles of bond-maintaining goodness and mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies secure trust, following descendants, dispersal, catching up, and a remote kinship-fabric branch; I infer that mercy repairs relational distance without dissolving agency, while the live alternative is that the meat branch in 52:22 contributes no contextual kinship sense.

changed_reading.before: The Merciful rescues the individual callers.
changed_reading.after: Mercy also repairs generational distance, gathering a dispersed lineage into a durable kinship fabric while preserving each member's agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden excludes speech cast aside as inconsequential. Read forward into the focus, their remembered call is the opposite kind of utterance: voiced approach whose consequence is disclosed by the title of truth that makes word and deed hold.

activation_trace.role: The voiced-calling branch supplies the utterance whose efficacy is being tested.
The truth-that-holds branch supplies consequence and reliability to the call-response relation.
The cast-off-and-unreckoned branch supplies the kind of empty speech explicitly absent from their destination.

structural_cues: The exclusion of لغو occurs shortly before the saved speakers narrate what they used to say to God.
The focus follows the remembered utterance with an emphatic account of the addressee's character.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a call, speech that is not counted, and truth that makes action hold; I infer a contrast between consequential prayer and discarded utterance, while the live alternative is that 52:23 describes only convivial speech in the garden.

changed_reading.before: Calling is one remembered act among others.
changed_reading.after: Calling becomes consequential speech: unlike لغو, it is not discarded, because the addressee's goodness holds in action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mutual facing and reciprocal questioning open a spoken testimony that repeats we were before, locates that interval among family in care mixed with fear, then reports unpriced release from penetrating heat. The focus repeats the temporal formula and supplies the prior action, making before a hinge between fearful household life and present security.

activation_trace.role: The priorness branch supplies the temporal hinge repeated from the preceding testimony.
The voiced-nearness branch supplies the previously undisclosed action performed during that earlier interval.
The mutual-facing branch supplies the secure present posture from which the account is exchanged.
The reciprocal-questioning branch supplies the social process that elicits the testimony.
The spoken-saying branch supplies public articulation rather than private memory.
The temporal-occurrence branch supplies the repeated past frame that the focus resumes.
The near-belonging-group branch supplies the household setting and makes the fear relational.
The care-mixed-with-fear branch supplies the affective pressure under which they called.
The release-without-price branch supplies gift rather than payment as the mode of rescue.
The protective-warding branch supplies the concrete transition from fear to security.
The penetrating-hot-wind branch supplies the invasive harm from which protection is experienced.

structural_cues: 52:26 and 52:28 repeat إنا كنا ... قبل with only the interior circumstance changing.
The sequence runs from facing and mutual questioning to former household fear, divine protection, prior calling, and emphatic naming.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition, household fear, gratuitous release, protection, and prior calling; I infer that the speakers retrospectively connect their established orientation to present security, while the live alternative is praise without a claim that prayer caused rescue.

changed_reading.after: Before hinges two lived postures: fearful care within a household and secure face-to-face testimony after freely given protection.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates remote fetus, womb, and afterbirth branches from words whose contextual senses are gardens, mercy, and punishment; it remains anchored to الرحيم, repeated warding, and the protected enclosure in 52:24, so downstream prose should call it a material birth analogy and not claim obstetric denotation.

activation_trace.role: The post-birth womb-ailment branch supplies bodily danger at the threshold of emergence.
The fetus-hidden-in-the-belly branch supplies vulnerable life enclosed before emergence.
The protective-cover branch supplies a guarded enclosure before entry into the social scene.
The afterbirth-and-uterine-discharge branch supplies a remote material image at the punishment from which they are guarded.
The protective-warding branch supplies safe passage through the activated bodily danger.

changed_reading.before: The Merciful protects them from punishment.
changed_reading.after: At a remote material level, mercy resembles guarded re-delivery: hidden life, protective enclosure, a dangerous threshold, and safe emergence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant split mapping of د ع و and a form-distant cry addressed to a stumbler; it remains packet-valid through that exact focus branch, the focus's rising-over branch, and the context's secure reclining, so it should be rendered as a movement activation and never as the lexical gloss of ندعوه.

activation_trace.role: The cry-to-a-stumbler branch supplies an exploratory summons to rise within the focus call.
The overcoming-and-rising branch supplies upward recovery as a possible effect associated with the addressee.
The leaning-on-a-support branch supplies secure reclining as the destination after recovered footing.

changed_reading.before: They called for help before rescue.
changed_reading.after: At the split-root margin, the call cues the stumbling to rise, while the destination converts precarious collapse into unthreatened reclining.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ءامنوا and إيمان denote faith in 52:21, not a spoken amen; it remains anchored because the packet explicitly supplies the amen-seeking-response branch beside the focus's voiced call and kinship title, so downstream prose should mark it as an acoustic-root activation rather than syntax or translation.

activation_trace.role: The voiced-calling branch supplies the ancestral utterance awaiting response.
The kinship-bond branch supplies the generational channel across which the response resonates.
The amen-seeking-response branch supplies an acoustic image of descendants answering and extending the earlier call.
The catching-up branch supplies the reunion through which the generational response becomes socially concrete.

changed_reading.before: The descendants independently share their ancestors' faith.
changed_reading.after: As a contained acoustic activation, descendants' faith sounds like a generational amen that carries the ancestors' prior call into reunion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because كنا is ordinary temporal predication and مكنون describes concealment, while the reading follows their shared split-mapped surety branch; it remains anchored to exact packet mappings and the protective-cover branch, so downstream prose should present undertaken responsibility only as a latent overlay on being and concealment.

activation_trace.role: The surety-and-undertaking branch supplies an exploratory sense of being held under responsibility.
The same split-mapped surety branch makes concealed preciousness activate undertaken care.
The protective-cover branch supplies the material form taken by that undertaken care.
The tenderness branch supplies the motive that keeps surety from becoming mere possession.

changed_reading.before: We used to describes only their former activity.
changed_reading.after: As a split-map overlay, their former being and the concealed pearl image suggest lives already held under a tender undertaking.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because قبل in the focus and 52:26 is temporal, while the reading activates its favorable-reception branch and a remote fulfillment branch from reciprocal questioning; it remains anchored to the repeated root, the actual call, and the narrated gift and protection, so downstream prose should qualify acceptance as retrospective resonance rather than grammatical meaning.

activation_trace.role: The favorable-reception branch supplies an exploratory accepted quality beneath temporal before.
The voiced-calling branch supplies the request-like address that may be received.
The fulfillment-of-a-request branch supplies a remote response image activated by the group's later questioning.
The unpriced-release branch supplies the form taken by favorable reception.
The warding-of-harm branch supplies the observable outcome from which acceptance is inferred.

changed_reading.before: Before only locates the call in earlier time.
changed_reading.after: As a contained retrospective overlay, before also glints with favorable reception: the prior call is narrated from inside its gifted answer.

strongest_changes: Prior calling became a durable orientation whose repeated temporal hinge joins fearful household life to secure face-to-face testimony.
البر الرحيم became enacted protection and sheltered abundance, not merely two abstract qualities.
The food sequence activated a nourishing register of البر, while deed, pledge, and unpriced release kept consequence and gift co-present.
Descendant reunion activated mercy as kinship repair without erasing individual agency.
The exclusion of لغو made the remembered call consequential speech whose addressee makes word and deed hold.
summary.what_was_special: The split د ع و and ك ن ن mappings, the temporal-facing-accepting range of ق ب ل, and remote material branches of ب ر ر, ر ح م, ء م ن, ع ذ ب, and ل ح م supported simultaneous nourishment, kinship, rebirth, amen, surety, rising, and acceptance readings without forcing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The sequence supports a retrospective link between prior calling and rescue, but grammar alone does not assert that the call caused rescue.
The favorable-reception sense of ق ب ل may resonate with the temporal قبل, or may remain only a branch-level afterimage.
Grain, womb and afterbirth, amen, surety, kinship-fabric, and the stumbler's rising cry are packet-backed activations but remain branch-distant rather than lexical replacements.
The coexistence of deed-consequence and unpriced favor may be a real theological tension or simply two complementary descriptions of one outcome.
